description: This is a Go source file that processes Android build blueprint files, parses them into an AST, flattens module definitions, and outputs the data in JSON or Bash format. It includes functions for parsing, property expansion, and output formatting.

methods.name: expandScalarTypeExpression
methods.description: Expands a parser.Expression to a scalar value if possible.

methods.name: populatePropertyMap
methods.description: Recursively populates a property map from a parser.Map.

methods.name: flattenModule
methods.description: Converts a parser.Module into a flattened FlatModule with a property map.

methods.name: processFile
methods.description: Reads and parses a file, returning a list of flattened modules.

methods.name: quoteBashString
methods.description: Escapes dollar signs in strings for Bash output.

methods.name: printBash
methods.description: Outputs flattened modules in Bash array and associative array format.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the command-line tool.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that handles command-line arguments, processes files, and outputs results.
